settings.title: Source
settings.text: We collect pre-owned devices from corporate trade-ins, insurance returns and individuals — never grey-market liquidators.

settings.title: Inspect
settings.text: Every item runs a 50-point diagnostic by a certified technician. Functionality, battery health, screen, ports, sensors — all logged.

settings.title: Repair
settings.text: Genuine parts only. Batteries replaced when health falls below 85%. Components swapped, not glued. Data wiped to NIST 800-88 standard.

settings.title: Grade
settings.text: An independent technician assigns the final grade (A/B/C/D) using real photographs and a written condition note.

settings.title: Ship
settings.text: Packaged in 100% recycled materials, shipped carbon-neutral, backed by a 14-day return window and 12-month warranty.
